newsitem.title: FRANCE: TENNIS-DAY ONE CURIOSITIES AT ROLAND GARROS.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-DAY ONE CURIOSITIES AT ROLAND GARROS.

text.p: A brief selection of curiosities from the opening day of the French Open:
Best quote - "The French Open is tougher on the mind. It's not really tennis, it's more like a fight." World number one Pete Sampras on the qualities needed to win at Roland Garros.
Stat of the day - Germany's Marc Kevin Goellner served 25 aces past fifth seed Thomas Muster -- and still lost in five sets.
Boldest fashion statements - Venus Williams' shiny silver tennis dress; Spaniard Francisco Clavet's dyed pink hair.
